name: Netorare Hiyori
source:
Hiyori Kohinata. She's my aunt, my family and my teacher. The only thing she cannot be is my lover. But I still can't forgive any other man to have sex with her. She's sweet, and can be easily charmed by men. I have to watch her constantly. There are rivals everywhere.

Gym teacher, classmate, pervert guy all in the same school... I 've got one month to graduation. One month to keep her faithful.

Busy.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ076596.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
小日向日和。她是我的阿姨，是我的家人，也是我的老师。唯一不能成为的，就是我的恋人。可要我眼看她和别的男人上床，我还是无法原谅。她待人温柔，又容易被男人哄住，我非时时留心不可。这里可到处都是情敌。

同一所学校里的体育老师、同班同学，还有色狼…再过一个月我就毕业了。我得在这一个月里守住她的心。

真忙。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ076596.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
